ARIA ARTEX integration evaluation

Mission Control now presents linked asset and investigation records, task supervision, retained coordination, historical review decisions, and scoped HTTP inspection. The existing FastAPI and PostgreSQL stores supply the records. This evaluation covers software behavior and controlled fixtures.

Reference and architecture

ARTEX documents typed asset and exploration graphs, evidence links, traffic records and usage supervision. ARIA represents those concepts as read-oriented views with shared record IDs, relationship reasons and visible missing references. FastAPI added a versioned owner-only traffic read endpoint. Existing database tables, report authority and accounting services supply the data. The frontend uses the native Mission Control shell and existing SVG renderer.

Validation

Ran 886 tests in 38.315s. Result passed. Visible Chromium 156.0.8078.4 passed 4 of 4 focused workflow groups. Compatibility scenarios passed 41 of 41. Disposable PostgreSQL checks covered migration and readiness, durable event paging, durable task trace, durable traffic metadata, durable campaign archive, foreign admin denied, durable receipt allowlist, durable web replay summary, durable authorization history, server admission explanation, durable accounting projection, fresh process readback, concurrent review disposition, visible database browser.

The retained inspection cohort covered immutable finding history, encrypted HAR detail, concurrent import deduplication, and isolation. Visible Chromium passed 5 of 5 focused groups and 41 of 41 compatibility scenarios. Disposable PostgreSQL supported 9 visible workflows. Ran 888 tests in 40.480s. Result passed.

The saved checkpoint cohort restored an earlier finding state, navigated a retained dependency, disclosed missing sequences and unreadable records, and cleared history on engagement switch. Two fresh API processes produced the same saved checkpoint. Visible Chromium passed 5 of 5 focused groups and 41 of 41 compatibility scenarios. Disposable PostgreSQL supported 10 visible workflows. Ran 888 tests in 44.327s. Result passed. These follow-up offline cohorts exclude four in-process vulnerability reproduction tests.

The linked-assets cohort traversed a mapped capture and its backing Traffic and catalog records, grouped an explicit default-port alias, and verified that switching engagements cleared the saved inspection. Visible Chromium passed 5 of 5 focused groups and 41 of 41 compatibility scenarios. Disposable PostgreSQL supported 11 visible workflows. Ran 888 tests in 43.508s. Result passed.

The configured worker capability probe returned unreachable. The probe describes advertisement and connectivity. Runtime execution, live model evaluation and independent human quality remain separate acceptance gates.

Focused Python tests cover malformed retained capture data, redaction, invalid pagination, unauthenticated access and foreign-owner denial. Browser checks use synthetic data and labelled evidence. Model quality, independent human review and live worker outcomes have no new evaluation evidence.

Reproduce

mkdir -p .local-lab/artex
npm --prefix web/mission-control run build -- --outDir /tmp/aria-artex-retained-assets
.venv/bin/python -B -m integration.artex_regressions > .local-lab/artex/assets-regressions.log 2>&1
.venv/bin/python -B -m integration.artex_browser --assets /tmp/aria-artex-retained-assets --output .local-lab/artex/assets-browser
.venv/bin/python -B -m integration.artex_browser --assets /tmp/aria-artex-retained-assets --output .local-lab/artex/assets-compatibility --existing-suite
.venv/bin/python -B -m integration.mission_disposable --headed --assets /tmp/aria-artex-retained-assets --output .local-lab/artex/assets-postgres/postgres.json
.venv/bin/python -B -m integration.artex_report

The entry bundle is archived locally under .local-lab/artex/baseline-assets. Its nine files match the baseline run's SHA-256 manifest. Use that directory with the same browser harness and --baseline --output .local-lab/artex/baseline to rerun the baseline.
